meta.title: Rudolf Steiner Hierarchical Chronology — comparative source audit v0.5
meta.notice: Events are source-attributed Steiner claims, predictions, or editorial syntheses, not empirical scientific or historical facts. Evidence P indicates a pertinent excerpt checked, not exhaustive lecture review.
meta.citation_caveat: The November 4 1919 Ahrimanic-incarnation lecture is catalogued as GA 193; a legacy anthology link may include GA191 in its path.
meta.prior_version_note: Retains all 330 v0.4 events and adds 50 entries.

events.title: Prior spiritual duration.
events.description: Steiner differentiates non-temporal spiritual "duration" from time as it first becomes outwardly manifest with Old Saturn warmth.

events.title: Spiritual agency precedes observable materiality.
events.description: The relevant origin is an activity of spiritual beings, not a physical Big Bang or a dated astronomical event.

events.title: Great cycles have pauses.
events.description: Cosmic rest or "sleep of worlds" intervenes between major conditions; subsequent activity first recapitulates earlier achievements in transformed fashion.

events.title: Inheritance rather than replacement.
events.description: Later work elaborates previous germs; earlier spiritual agency does not simply vanish when another hierarchy comes to the foreground.

events.title: Foundational outpouring of will.
events.description: Spirits of Will / Thrones pour forth will, providing the earliest basis for a human corporeal germ.

events.title: Warmth existence.
events.description: A warmth-condition, not present solid matter, characterizes the outward Saturn state.

events.title: Origin of time.
events.description: Steiner places the emergence of time in connection with manifest warmth.

events.title: Spirits of Wisdom.
events.description: Their activity relates to the reflection of life; this does not mean that Saturn germs are modern living bodies.

events.title: Spirits of Movement.
events.description: Soul-like qualities begin to be expressed/reflected in Saturn's evolution.

events.title: Spirits of Form.
events.description: Greater differentiation and relative individualization of Saturn manifestations appears.

events.title: Spirits of Personality.
events.description: Personality-like organization and modes of consciousness arise in the descriptions of the stage.

events.title: Fire Spirits / Archangels.
events.description: Steiner associates their activity with original germinal sense-organ developments, not finished eyes or ears.

events.title: Seraphim / Spirits of Love.
events.description: Their participation in the sense-organ and Fire-Spirit account is also described; avoid exclusive one-spirit-to-one-organ mapping.

events.title: Germ of Spirit-Man.
events.description: A seed of a future higher human member appears in the account without being the fully attained Spirit-Man of future humanity.

events.title: Faint mineral-like consciousness.
events.description: Consciousness is compared with the darkest form of contemporary mineral consciousness, not ordinary awake human awareness.

events.title: Dissolution and cosmic night.
events.description: Old Saturn withdraws into rest; its achievement is preserved as a germ for Old Sun.

events.title: Saturn's physical germ is not mineralized matter
events.description: In GA 13, the physical germ is a warmth-governed body; the solid mineral body belongs to a later Earth condition.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Spirits of Personality pass their human stage
events.description: The Archai or Spirits of Personality attain what Steiner calls their human stage on Saturn through reflected ego-awareness.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Sons of Life and Cherubim affect Saturn's living semblance
events.description: The Sons of Life and Cherubim influence what appears as inner life, but Saturn's human germ does not yet possess an autonomous life-body.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Hierarchy work is simultaneous beyond its prominent phases
events.description: Steiner warns that hierarchical ranks do not act only in the particular phases where they are most conspicuous.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Recapitulation of Saturn.
events.description: The earlier stages are repeated under changed conditions prior to a new evolutionary advance.

events.title: Gift of life/etheric organization.
events.description: Spirits of Wisdom impart the life-body germ to the developing human being.

events.title: Warmth condenses to air/gas.
events.description: A new tenuous physical condition is present alongside warmth.

events.title: Light manifests.
events.description: Light and life-processes appear in connection with the Sun evolution.

events.title: Plant-like processes.
events.description: The human germ acquires internally moving, vegetative processes; this is an analogy, not an identification with today's plants.

events.title: Differentiation of physical and life bodies.
events.description: Steiner describes a process of separation and reorganization of these principles.

events.title: Further hierarchical work.
events.description: Movement and Form and other spiritual beings participate in elaboration, stabilization and sensory beginnings.

events.title: Retarded stages and other kingdoms.
events.description: Beings/entities that cannot follow the main development contribute to differentiated evolutionary streams.

events.title: Sleep-like consciousness.
events.description: Sun-stage consciousness is compared to present sleep.

events.title: Germ of Life-Spirit.
events.description: The future Buddhi principle receives a germinal origin in this account.

events.title: Sun cosmic night.
events.description: The Sun condition closes, with results carried into the later Moon condition.

events.title: Sun begins by recapitulating Saturn in a changed form
events.description: The Saturn achievements are reworked before the Spirits of Wisdom pour the life-body into the developing human germ.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Spirits of Personality and Seraphim foster reproductive beginnings
events.description: The GA 13 Sun account describes joint activity on the etheric body leading to the first hints of reproduction.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Fire Spirits attain their human stage
events.description: GA 13 locates an Archangelic or Fire-Spirit 'human' level during Old Sun, working through an inherited Saturn element.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: A separated Saturn-like sphere appears
events.description: The account introduces a secondary Saturn-like body associated with delayed Spirits of Personality during Old Sun.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Glandular organ germs are traced to Old Sun
events.description: Steiner associates the earliest glandular precursors with Spirits of Personality and Seraphim; no modern glands are asserted.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Recapitulation of Saturn and Sun.
events.description: The Old Moon starts with transformed repetitions of former stages.

events.title: Astral body bestowed.
events.description: Spirits of Movement supply the germ of the astral organization.

events.title: Feeling, sympathy and antipathy.
events.description: An inner soul responsiveness develops through the astral member.

events.title: Wish, craving and instinct.
events.description: Work of Spirits of Form contributes to relatively enduring desire patterns.

events.title: Watery element.
events.description: A further density corresponding to fluid/water joins the older warmth and air conditions.

events.title: Separation of Sun and Moon.
events.description: Differentiation into spheres enables different classes of beings and forces to work from different positions.

events.title: Alternating influences.
events.description: Changing relations of separated spheres shape lunar beings and their development.

events.title: Dreamlike picture consciousness.
events.description: The Moon-phase level is described as imaginative, picture-forming consciousness.

events.title: Embryonic soul members.
events.description: Beginnings associated with later sentient/intellectual soul and a Spirit-Self germ are traced to this stage.

events.title: Kingdoms and lagging beings.
events.description: Different levels of evolution coexist; labels should not be mistaken for Earth's present mineral/plant/animal classifications.

events.title: Final rest and preparation.
events.description: Old Moon ends; a cosmic interval prepares Earth's distinct task.

events.title: Old Moon repeats inherited warmth and gaseous phases
events.description: GA 13 describes repetition of Saturn and Sun qualities prior to the specifically lunar astral incorporation.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Moon stage combines water, air and warmth
events.description: The account describes a liquid-like physical organization permeated by gaseous currents and warmth effects.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Multiple developmental kingdoms coexist on Old Moon
events.description: Steiner describes differently advanced kingdoms, including ones retaining earlier Saturn-like and Sun-like conditions.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Sun–Moon differentiation allows alternating spiritual influences
events.description: The separation of spheres changes the forces working upon the lunar human ancestor and its states of inner activity.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Sons of Life human stage marks Old Moon culmination
events.description: GA 13 connects the Sons of Life reaching their human stage with a culminating phase and late seed-forming soul development.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Recapitulations at the beginning.
events.description: Earth development reprises earlier Saturn, Sun and Moon achievements; these repeats are not identical new planetary embodiments.

events.title: New earthly element and solidity.
events.description: Earth is associated with the fully developed domain of solid/mineral conditions as earlier forces are reworked.

events.title: Human "I" becomes the central task.
events.description: Spirits of Form / Exusiai are described as crucial to the independent ego germ of Earth humanity.

events.title: Wisdom is to become love.
events.description: Steiner presents terrestrial evolution as transforming inherited cosmic wisdom through a specifically human moral/spiritual task.

events.title: Descent and re-ascent.
events.description: Earth's movement from spiritual conditions toward density, then toward spiritual transformation, spans several great Earth epochs.

events.title: No simple replacement of old members.
events.description: Physical, etheric and astral bodies remain conditions of the developing "I"; the future transformation of lower members is prospective.

events.title: The human I is youngest of the four members
events.description: GA 13 explicitly contrasts the physical body's fourth maturation with the I being only at its first stage.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: The Earth condition develops object consciousness
events.description: GA 11 distinguishes the appearance of external spatial objects from earlier dreamlike internal images.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Thinking becomes a basis for earthly self-consciousness
events.description: GA 11 links earthly concepts, thought and memory with the ability to recognize oneself as an independent I.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Wisdom becomes the seed of cosmic love
events.description: GA 13 portrays inherited cosmic wisdom becoming inner wisdom in the human I and, in future development, love.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Earliest Earth-human manifestations.
events.description: Accounts speak of much finer, predominantly spiritual-etheric humanity, not anatomically modern bodies.

events.title: Earth/Sun initially together.
events.description: Steiner's earliest Earth story begins with a united condition prior to differentiation.

events.title: No modern continents or chronology.
events.description: The term "Polar" names a spiritual-scientific epoch, not a verified archaeological settlement.

events.title: Continuity from earlier cosmic work.
events.description: Human germinal constituents are inherited from preceding conditions, in recapitulated form.

events.title: Solar separation.
events.description: The sun separates from Earth in the account, changing which spiritual forces act from within or from outside.

events.title: Differentiation of life environments.
events.description: Different beings and human germs require differently organized cosmic surroundings.

events.title: Life conditions remain nonmodern.
events.description: Do not depict recognizably modern people, plants or landscapes simply because old names resemble geography.

events.title: Preparation for lunar separation.
events.description: As terrestrial density becomes problematic, further separation is described as necessary.

events.title: Earth's moon separates.
events.description: The withdrawal of lunar forces is presented as making human embodiment and further development possible.

events.title: Human bodies increasingly plastic and then denser.
events.description: Steiner describes changing interaction of spirit/soul with corporeality.

events.title: Soul and body unite differently.
events.description: Reincarnating souls become able to enter and develop bodies under changed lunar conditions.

events.title: Sexual differentiation.
events.description: GA 13 links emerging sexual differentiation to lunar departure and changed seed and quickening forces. GA 11 emphasizes densification and redirected force. Their precise cross-work chronology remains open.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 69–71, 78

events.title: Reproduction and seed forces.
events.description: The changing relation of generative and animating forces is key to the transition in bodily development.

events.title: Emergence of human inwardness.
events.description: The ego is increasingly related to an embodied life, though not yet modern rational self-consciousness.

events.title: Luciferic intervention.
events.description: Steiner connects the Luciferic influence with new independence, desire and the possibility of error.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 80–82, 88

events.title: Expanded scope of free action and its dangers.
events.description: Earthly and fiery forces can be misdirected in Steiner's narrative.

events.title: Linguistic and memorial seeds.
events.description: Some capacities for naming, memory and social activity first emerge in rudiments.

events.title: Initiation and early guidance.
events.description: Spiritual teachers, inspired leadership, and nature-related forms of instruction feature in GA 11's narrative.

events.title: Catastrophe of fire.
events.description: The later Lemurian downfall is characterized through destructive fiery processes.

events.title: Survival and migration.
events.description: A group capable of progressing forms a bridge to the Atlantean period.

events.title: Editorial restraint.
events.description: GA 11 uses obsolete "root-race" and gender-essentialist classifications. These are historically important to document but should not be endorsed, modernized into ethnic taxonomy, or represented as facts about living peoples.

events.title: Rmoahals (first).
events.description: Steiner places pronounced sense-based memory, naming and early language among the first distinguishing capacities.

events.title: Tlavatlis (second).
events.description: Development of remembered achievements, status and the social relation of personal experience to others requires full GA 11 comparison.

events.title: Toltecs (third).
events.description: Greater organization and direction of powers, authority and inherited skills are associated with this phase; verify paragraph-level attribution.

events.title: Original Turanians (fourth).
events.description: In the fourth named phase, GA 11 places intensified personal misuse of life forces. In the fifth it describes judgment restraining desire. The phase labels are source terms from obsolete racial typology.

events.title: Original Semites (fifth).
events.description: One part of the early theosophical account associates the transition toward combining intellectual judgment and self-consciousness with this phase. This is an obsolete esoteric category, not a claim about modern Jews or Semitic-speaking peoples.

events.title: Akkadians (sixth).
events.description: GA 11 assigns wider social application of thinking and regulation by general law to its sixth phase. It distinguishes the seventh phase through its more persistent allegiance to inherited memory.

events.title: Mongols (seventh).
events.description: The seventh label is recorded as source terminology only, not as a representation of a modern population.

events.title: Powerful pictorial memory.
events.description: Steiner contrasts remembered image and experience with later analytical judgment.

events.title: Expansion of speech.
events.description: Naming, recollection and speech develop together.

events.title: Life/germinating forces.
events.description: Narratives include manipulating growth and living forces, even proposed vehicles; these descriptions are esoteric, not evidenced technological history.

events.title: Residual clairvoyance.
events.description: Immediate spiritual experience persists while perceptual orientation toward the outer physical world grows.

events.title: Atlantean oracles.
events.description: Multiple oracle currents are described as distinct modes of spiritual guidance; their institutional history should not be mapped one-to-one to all seven phase labels.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 91–94

events.title: Christ/Sun oracle.
events.description: A culminating Sun-related initiation stream is presented as distinct from other oracle influences.

events.title: Ahrimanic influence strengthens.
events.description: The account places decisive Ahrimanic intervention around the *middle of Atlantis*, not exclusively in any one subphase.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 95–97

events.title: The "I" awakens within bodily perception.
events.description: Growing external object perception and independent judgment displace older forms of spiritual awareness.

events.title: Differentiated spiritual agencies persist.
events.description: Luciferic, Ahrimanic and higher guidance are cross-cutting processes, not a sequence of one actor departing when another arrives.

events.title: Guidance of a successor group.
events.description: Steiner recounts the Sun-oracle initiate guiding people eastward as post-Atlantean development is prepared.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · IV. Transition of the Fourth into the Fifth Root Race · §§ 4–8, 10–12

events.title: Atlantean flood/ice-water catastrophe.
events.description: The epoch ends in a catastrophe described in spiritual terms; it is not established geological history.

events.title: Transition to post-Atlantis.
events.description: Out of surviving earlier spiritual wisdom arise later forms of culture in which thought, individuality and moral freedom become increasingly central.

events.title: Preserved echo of Atlantean wisdom.
events.description: An early sacred teaching is described as uniting insights of multiple oracle streams.

events.title: Seven holy Rishis.
events.description: Steiner refers to great teachers of original Indian wisdom; the sources should distinguish these from later textual or historical identifications.

events.title: Nearness to spiritual reality.
events.description: GA 13 depicts a receptive successor culture oriented toward a remembered spiritual homeland. It distinguishes this first epoch from later historical India and allows its continuation during the next two dominant cultures.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 100–102

events.title: Source limitation.
events.description: The Vedas are described by Steiner as a *later echo*, not a complete transcript of the first period.

events.title: Relationship to seventh period.
events.description: Steiner projects a transformed return of first-period wisdom in the seventh post-Atlantean age.

events.title: Zarathustra-related teaching.
events.description: GA 13 connects the second period with work on Earth and a teaching about the spiritual world behind sensory life. Steiner distinguishes his primordial Zarathustra from the later bearers of the name.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 103–104, 107

events.title: Contrast of light and darkness.
events.description: Ahrimanic opposition receives conceptual expression in Persian teaching; do not equate this with a complete literal history of Zoroastrianism.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 103–104, 107

events.title: Earth as field of labor.
events.description: Transformation and cultivation are important interpretive themes.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 103–104, 107

events.title: Relationship to sixth period.
events.description: Steiner says a transformed analogue or revival of ancient Persian spiritual content will arise in the sixth age.

events.title: Star/world relationships.
events.description: GA 104 links Chaldean attention to stellar movements with apprehending patterns in visible nature. Pergamum represents the third culture in this lecture.

events.title: Egyptian mysteries.
events.description: GA 13 credits Hermes with preparing people during earthly life for the spiritual world. It situates Egyptian and Chaldean traditions within a wider change in sensory and postmortem experience.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 105, 107–109

events.title: Further embodiment and external perception.
events.description: Relations between soul, body, natural events and religious symbolism change.

events.title: Later echo in the fifth age.
events.description: The third period is said to reappear metamorphosed during the fifth post-Atlantean period.

events.title: Cultural caveat.
events.description: These are Steiner's broad types and must not erase historical variation, genuine scholarly chronologies, or other contemporaneous cultures.

events.title: Development of intellectual/mind soul.
events.description: Steiner places the fourth period under the development of the intellectual or feeling soul.

events.title: Individual thinking and outer embodiment.
events.description: Human consciousness becomes more inwardly individualized and closely connected to the physical world.

events.title: Three subperiods.
events.description: Steiner separately outlines ~747–27 BCE, ~27 BCE–693 CE, and ~693–1413 CE; these are subdivisions inside the fourth cultural period, not three extra post-Atlantean cultures.

audited_passages.citation: GA 184 · Lecture Four · 747 BCE / 1413 and 2,160-year calculation

events.title: Approaching the Christ turning point.
events.description: The diminishing earlier direct spiritual relationship gives new significance to the Christ event.

events.title: Birth and life of Jesus of Nazareth.
events.description: In Steiner's Christology, prepare a linked dossier on the two Jesus-child narratives and the Jordan baptism; these must not be simplistically conflated.

events.title: Baptism in the Jordan.
events.description: Steiner describes the cosmic Christ uniting with Jesus at a decisive point before the Mystery of Golgotha.

events.title: Mystery of Golgotha (first century CE).
events.description: Steiner treats the death and resurrection as the central terrestrial/spiritual historical intervention.

events.title: Effects beyond visible history.
events.description: Golgotha transforms, in Steiner's narrative, the experiences of souls in the spiritual world after death.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 106–112

events.title: Christ impulse and the human I.
events.description: The human capacity for further free spiritual development is linked to Christ, not merely to restoration of old clairvoyance.

events.title: Spread and reworking of spiritual knowledge.
events.description: Early Christianity, Gnosis and later developments form a complex, not single-step, process.

events.title: Gradual decline of original Gnostic capacities.
events.description: GA 191 places a fading of old Lucifer-influenced comprehension by the fourth century CE.

events.title: Medieval transformation and transitional centuries.
events.description: Steiner distinguishes changes in the twelfth/thirteenth centuries and in the transition to modern consciousness.

events.title: Beginning of the modern fifth age (~1413).
events.description: A gradual transition replaces the fourth age's typical inner constitution.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · VI. Present and Future Evolution of the World and of Mankind · §§ 3–6

events.title: Central task: consciousness soul.
events.description: A person must come to independent self-consciousness, judgment and moral responsibility rather than rely on inherited clairvoyance.

events.title: Physical-world orientation grows.
events.description: Scientific intellectual power and a risk of spiritually closed materialism belong to this period's tensions.

events.title: Echo of the third period.
events.description: In Steiner's scheme, Egypto-Chaldean material is to be consciously transformed and renewed, not simply repeated.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · VI. Present and Future Evolution of the World and of Mankind · §§ 6–7

events.title: Freedom and moral intuition.
events.description: Independent ethical action becomes an important practice of mature thinking.

events.title: Reorientation of spiritual knowledge.
events.description: Modern spiritual investigation must be pursued consciously rather than duplicating ancient mystery practices.

events.title: Lucifer and Ahriman as contemporaneous influences.
events.description: Exaggerated disembodied spirituality and hardening/materialistic one-sidedness are both discussed as risks; Steiner calls for a conscious balance, not their simple physical expulsion.

events.title: Michael age (1879 onward).
events.description: Steiner reports a new Michaelic spiritual guidance at the end of the 1870s; it unfolds within the fifth cultural period.

events.title: End of Kali Yuga (1899).
events.description: He presents this as the closing of a "dark age" and the possibility of changed modes of spiritual recognition.

events.title: Etheric Christ perception (20th century onward).
events.description: The 1910 lecture anticipates a newly available perception, particularly associated with the 1930s; a prediction, not a verified event.

events.title: Specific anticipated years (1933/1935/1937).
events.description: Steiner named these years in connection with new faculties, while also warning they might go unrecognized.

events.title: Lucifer incarnation located in far earlier history.
events.description: In 1919 he locates a Lucifer incarnation in the early third millennium BCE; the claim belongs chronologically under the third/second periods but is cross-linked here because he introduced it in a modern lecture.

events.title: Ahrimanic incarnation projected.
events.description: GA 193 predicts a future earthly incarnation of Ahriman without establishing a historically confirmed occurrence; popular precise date claims require lecture-level scrutiny.

events.title: Social threefolding as modern task (1919).
events.description: Freedom in spiritual/cultural life, equality in rights, and associative economic cooperation belong to Steiner's practical response to modern conditions.

events.title: Inner moral imagination and creativity.
events.description: Consciously originated ethical action is an active human contribution, not recovery of lost Atlantean technology.

events.title: Transformation of egoism.
events.description: The evolution of self-consciousness must become capacity for responsibility and love rather than self-enclosure.

events.title: Future dangers within the present period.
events.description: Warnings about spiritually disconnected cleverness, misuse of technologies and authoritarian tendencies are predictions/normative critiques, not timelines of proven future events.

events.title: Forthcoming bridge to the sixth.
events.description: Steiner stresses that the fifth and sixth ages are crucial for consciously combining spiritual insight with human intelligence and feeling.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 114–115

events.title: Continuing activity of spiritual beings.
events.description: The human I's freedom is not portrayed as a rejection of all hierarchies; interacting spiritual agency continues through evolution.

events.title: No numerical certainty about modern spiritual events.
events.description: Dates for invisible events and higher beings belong to source-attributed teaching, not externally certified observations.

events.title: Future cultural age, not the sixth planetary condition.
events.description: This comes before the war of all against all, still within the fifth great Earth epoch.

events.title: Transformed echo of ancient Persia.
events.description: Spiritual insights and work upon the world are expected to return in a new, conscious manner.

events.title: Conscious spirituality and cooperation.
events.description: Those who have united intellect, feeling and spiritual understanding are particularly prepared for what follows.

events.title: Developing future faculties.
events.description: Avoid assuming a detailed biological or political forecast where Steiner gives only a spiritual characterization.

events.title: "Philadelphia" symbolism.
events.description: GA 104 connects the sixth cultural age with the apocalyptic church of Philadelphia; it is *not* the identical category as the seven seals after the later catastrophe.

events.title: Final cultural period of the fifth great Earth epoch.
events.description: It precedes a greater transition and is not the terminal end of all terrestrial evolution.

events.title: Ancient Indian wisdom transformed.
events.description: Steiner projects a return of primordial spiritual knowledge now consciously won by the individual.

events.title: Differentiation of paths.
events.description: Some souls are pictured as prepared for the next great period, others as increasingly unadapted; treat these as Steiner's spiritual moral categories, not classifications of living groups.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · VI. Present and Future Evolution of the World and of Mankind · §§ 7

events.title: Climactic social/moral crisis.
events.description: The war of all against all is foretold as the fifth great epoch closes.

events.title: Date precision not guaranteed.
events.description: ~7893 CE is the arithmetic terminus of a 2,160-year scheme, not a demonstrated date of literal catastrophe.

events.title: War of all against all.
events.description: A moral-human catastrophe, with attendant natural effects, separates the fifth great Earth epoch from the sixth.

events.title: Not to be confused with modern wars.
events.description: Steiner's forecast is an esoteric end-of-great-epoch concept, not a validated identification with World War I, II, or a present conflict.

events.title: Carrying seeds forward.
events.description: Moral/spiritual capacities acquired earlier are said to prepare humans for the conditions after the transition.

events.title: Seven further stages.
events.description: The future sixth great epoch is pictured as comprising seven subdivisions.

events.title: Seven seals as spiritual pictures.
events.description: Apocalyptic symbols describe stages of metamorphosis, not straightforward newspaper events.

events.title: Enhanced spiritual relation.
events.description: Humanity is said to gain a conscious spiritual community beyond earlier Atlantean clairvoyance.

events.title: Transformed body and form.
events.description: Progressive spiritualization makes later human embodiment unlike current physical anthropology.

events.title: Grouping by moral development.
events.description: Steiner predicts different evolutionary destinies; this is not a justification for coercion or prejudicial hierarchies in the present.

events.title: Further source audit required.
events.description: Exact one-to-one identification of every seal, its subdivisions and bodily transformations requires full GA 104/104a/346 reconciliation.

events.title: Seven trumpet stages.
events.description: A following great epoch is characterized by the seven trumpets.

events.title: Further transition beyond physical density.
events.description: After trumpet development, Earth advances to a different astral/spiritual form of existence in these accounts.

events.title: Apocalyptic conflict and consequences.
events.description: Steiner uses beast, bowls/vials and separation symbolism for divergent courses of evolution.

events.title: Interpreting the symbols.
events.description: Do not convert these into an invented date-by-date chronology of modern military or ecological events.

events.title: Return of the Moon.
events.description: In the far future, the Moon is said to reunite with Earth after human spiritual evolution has changed its ability to assimilate lunar forces.

events.title: Divergent moral development.
events.description: Steiner pictures prepared humanity and opposing, karmically burdened groups; this is an attribution, not an objectively grounded ranking.

events.title: Transformative help.
events.description: More advanced humanity is tasked with helping rather than merely discarding other beings.

events.title: Earth rejoins Sun and other planets.
events.description: The cosmic bodies' altered relationships enable Earth's eventual transformation.

events.title: Cosmic rest.
events.description: An interplanetary "sleep of worlds" intervenes before future Jupiter.

events.title: New planetary embodiment.
events.description: Future Jupiter is the metamorphosis of Earth after rest, incorporating results of both Old Moon inheritance and terrestrial moral development.

events.title: Present mineral kingdom disappears as such.
events.description: The lowest kingdom is described as plant-like, not today's botanical plant kingdom simply moved to a new planet.

events.title: Altered animal and human kingdoms.
events.description: New ranges of being and the consequences of earlier moral choices are envisioned.

events.title: Humanity as transforming agency.
events.description: The spiritual development of human beings determines what can be carried into this condition.

events.title: Renewed Sun/Jupiter separation.
events.description: The future condition includes a period of receiving solar influence from outside.

events.title: Higher consciousness.
events.description: Future Jupiter is linked in the broader account to new forms of consciousness, requiring cross-check of detailed terminological mappings.

events.title: Jupiter awakens conscious image-awareness
events.description: Both GA 11 and GA 104 describe an active, self-conscious mode of imaginative perception beyond present object consciousness.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Jupiter recapitulates earlier planetary conditions
events.description: GA 11 describes repetitions of Saturn, Sun, Moon and Earth before the specific Jupiter condition becomes manifest.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Jupiter includes the task of helping less-developed souls
events.description: Steiner's Jupiter account makes aid to divergent human developmental paths part of a higher humanity's work.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Further planetary metamorphosis.
events.description: Future Venus follows Jupiter after another major integration.

events.title: No plant kingdom as a separate lowest kingdom.
events.description: Steiner pictures the lowest remaining level as a greatly changed animal-like kingdom.

events.title: Further differentiated human kingdoms.
events.description: Several human developmental levels remain in the account.

events.title: Separate "irreclaimable moon."
events.description: One later separation is described for beings who persistently resist further evolution.

events.title: Solar relationship.
events.description: Sun/Venus relations are part of the transition and should not be equated with current astronomy.

events.title: Venus is associated with inspired consciousness
events.description: In GA 104, Inspiration is described as cognition of an inward soul nature through supersensible tone.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Venus consciousness adds an active creative dimension
events.description: GA 11 distinguishes the next condition from mere image-awareness through creative activity of the soul.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: A Sun–Jupiter reunification precedes Venus
events.description: GA 13 describes renewed union before the transformation into the Venus stage.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Most remote named future planetary condition.
events.description: Future Vulcan follows Venus and is considered analogous, on a higher level, to primordial Old Saturn.

events.title: Far-future outcome of human spiritualization.
events.description: Detailed faculties, kingdoms and forms should be stated only with exact further source passage audits.

events.title: Beyond the named cycle.
events.description: Do not claim that Steiner provides a fully specified, infinitely extending chronology beyond Vulcan on the basis of these sources.

events.title: Vulcan is characterized by intuition in GA 104
events.description: The lecture attributes the seventh state to participation in the inward being of spiritual realities.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: Intuitive participation does not erase individuality
events.description: The same lecture stresses that individuality remains in the seventh form of consciousness.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: GA 13 expressly limits Vulcan description
events.description: The book treats the development of spiritualized humanity on Vulcan as beyond its capacity for detailed description.
events.provenance: GA original English passage checked 2026-11-16; no German-language or full-volume audit.

events.title: First hierarchy.
events.description: Seraphim, Cherubim and Thrones appear as cosmic actors in the evolutionary narratives; "activity during" is not "sole creator of" a specific organ.

events.title: Second hierarchy.
events.description: Kyriotetes (Wisdom), Dynamis (Movement) and Exusiai (Form) mediate life, astrality, organization and Earth-ego development in different contexts.

events.title: Third hierarchy.
events.description: Archai/Spirits of Personality, Archangels/Fire Spirits and Angels/Sons of Life occupy changing roles over epochs.

events.title: Luciferic current.
events.description: In Steiner's historical narrative, Luciferic influences become especially important in Lemuria and remain relevant afterward.

events.title: Ahrimanic current.
events.description: Ahrimanic influences are significant from Atlantean development onward and are projected to grow especially acute in modern materialistic civilization.

events.title: Christ current.
events.description: The solar/Christ dimension precedes Golgotha; Golgotha is the unique Earth turning point in Steiner's Christology; its consequence continues after it.

events.title: Michael current.
events.description: Current Michaelic guidance is tied to the late nineteenth century but discussed as part of a longer supersensible history.

events.title: Different kinds of "agency."
events.description: Creator, giver of a member, former planetary guide, present physiologic activity, spiritual inspiration and symbolic correspondence must be tagged separately.

events.title: Physical germ — Old Saturn.
events.description: This is the *starting germ* of human physical organization, not a fully developed modern physical body.

events.title: Etheric/life germ — Old Sun.
events.description: Living growth and organization are added to what was prepared previously.

events.title: Astral/sentient germ — Old Moon.
events.description: Sensation and inner wish develop upon inherited physical/etheric bases.

events.title: I/ego germ — Earth.
events.description: Independent embodied ego-consciousness becomes the distinctive terrestrial work.

events.title: Spirit-Self, Life-Spirit, Spirit-Man.
events.description: These have earlier seeds yet are future developmental achievements of the working human I, not bodies added fully formed in chronological order.

events.title: Sensory organs.
events.description: Earliest *germs* of sense organs are connected to Saturn and Fire Spirits; actual human anatomy is a multistage product.

events.title: Heart, blood and other modern organs.
events.description: Organ-specific links must be imported *claim by claim* from the existing audited GA 313–317/GA 110/GA 102 dossiers; do not invent a single builder, date or first appearance for every organ.

events.title: Blood and I.
events.description: The Atlas needs a distinct evidence track for ego/blood, including historical cosmic claims and contemporary physiological symbolism; never equate that with a clinical medical fact.

events.title: Life forces and germinal forces.
events.description: Claims about Atlantean seed powers, medical etheric forces and the development of future organs require separation by source and time scale.

events.title: Ongoing collaboration.
events.description: Earlier hierarchies' continuing influence cannot be reduced to a succession in which each old class is wholly removed.

events.title: Between-death-and-birth spiritual existence.
events.description: The individuality has experiences and relationships before earthly embodiment in Steiner's worldview.

events.title: Descent into birth.
events.description: Karma, familial life and bodily formation are discussed as part of a renewed incarnation.

events.title: Development through childhood and adulthood.
events.description: Birth, growth, education and successive life periods have their own time scale.

events.title: Day–night cycle.
events.description: Waking/sleeping bodily and soul configurations recur during an incarnation; separate from "cosmic night.".

events.title: Death and the soul-world.
events.description: The physical death is followed in Steiner's description by processes of review and purification.

events.title: Spiritland and further development.
events.description: Postmortem experiences continue beyond immediate soul-world processes.

events.title: Karma and future incarnation.
events.description: Earlier lives can be understood, in Steiner's scheme, as conditioning subsequent individual situations.

events.title: Christ and postmortem life.
events.description: Steiner attributes a change to the life after death through Golgotha; locate this on a spiritual-history overlay, not a separate personal birth date.

events.title: Awakening of conscious thinking.
events.description: Present humanity must increasingly know rather than instinctively inherit spiritual relationships.

events.title: Freedom in ethics.
events.description: Mature moral imagination provides situational, responsible initiatives rather than mere external rule following.

events.title: Love as an evolutionary force.
events.description: Link exact passages about love and the transformation of wisdom before elevating this to a single linear chronology.

events.title: Culture, rights and economy.
events.description: Threefold society belongs to the modern response to spiritual and institutional unfreedom; distinguish Steiner's proposal from a prediction that it inevitably occurs.

events.title: Education, medicine, agriculture and arts.
events.description: These are fields of practical anthroposophical activity, each with its own historical chronology and corpus; their *future destiny* must not be invented from present program descriptions.

events.title: Scientific and medical assertions.
events.description: Organ evolution and descriptions of disability, illness, race or heredity must be clearly distinguished from contemporary evidence and must not be used as medical counsel or discriminatory classifications.

events.title: Etheric embodiment and hearing before the ear
events.description: Steiner places dreamlike astral image consciousness before entry into etheric materiality. External etheric vibration then yields an organism-wide precursor of hearing before a separate organ exists.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · VIII. The Hyperborean and the Polarean Epoch · §§ 2–3

events.title: Reproduction, death and perceptual differentiation
events.description: With condensation, reproduction changes from division to a locally mediated process, and the remaining body may disintegrate. Hearing localizes while touch still belongs to most of the body. Section 6 names the two early stages after the description of reproduction and death.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · VIII. The Hyperborean and the Polarean Epoch · §§ 4–7

events.title: External sunlight and the first eye rudiments
events.description: Part of the light ether is withdrawn at solar separation and subsequently acts from outside. Steiner relates this altered dependence to the first organs receptive to sunlight, followed by further densification and the fire-mist human constitution. The chapter itself gives relative order, while Hyperborean placement is an editorial crosswalk.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · IX. Beginning of the Present Earth—Extrusion of the Sun · §§ 7–9

events.title: Reproductive force redirected to inward organs
events.description: Steiner pictures older and newer reproductive forms coexisting. He connects density with redirecting part of the prior reproductive capacity into inward organs, mentioning the brain as an instrument of inwardly acquired cognition. He distinguishes early incomplete formation from readiness for spirit contact around mid-Lemuria.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · VI. The Division into Sexes · §§ 2–5, 8–9

events.title: Mobility and senses before division into sexes
events.description: In the late pre-division account, movement organs are comparatively developed. Hearing and touch are present earlier than light perception, which develops later in the life described. The text also situates extra-parental maturation and externally supplied heat before the later reproductive organization.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · VII. The Last Periods before the Division into Sexes · §§ 1–6

events.title: Two forms of spiritual influence on early humanity
events.description: Steiner assigns regulation of reproduction to advanced beings acting on the majority as instinct. A separate, less advanced group directs inner images toward the sensory environment, interrupting what he describes as an otherwise dreamlike spiritual life.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · VII. The Last Periods before the Division into Sexes · §§ 7–10

events.title: Fire mist, upright form and divided guidance
events.description: Thinking organs are prepared in the fire mist. After lunar separation and cooling, Steiner links upstanding posture and hand rudiments with altered functions of the upper body. He assigns lower-body guidance to Moon beings and renewed influence over developed personality to Luciferic beings.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · X. Extrusion of the Moon · §§ 3–6

events.title: Breath, warmth and early bodily systems
events.description: GA 13 attributes guidance of breath into the body to Sun beings. It distinguishes warmth currents as beginnings of blood circulation from an internal differentiation of air as a basis of the later nervous system. These are claimed antecedents, with no implication of modern anatomical completion.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 71–73

events.title: Interrupted embodiment, I and return
events.description: Some souls can no longer inhabit hardening forms and continue elsewhere. Spirits of Form kindle the I, whose experience carries into body-free existence. As suitable forms become available after Moon separation, formerly displaced souls return over a long interval. The account distinguishes these first returns from repeat Earth incarnations.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 74, 77–78, 87

events.title: Different nighttime agencies act concurrently
events.description: With alternating day and night, Steiner differentiates the nighttime sphere of activity around I and astral body from the simultaneous activity around physical and life bodies. Spirits of Form are common to both lists. This describes an early Earth rhythm, with a specific allocation of agencies rather than exclusive builders.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 85–87

events.title: Will, memory, speech and differentiated guidance
events.description: GA 11 describes will-directed schooling and temple practice, and connects late Lemurian memory and elementary moral concepts to an account of women's role and of rhythmic utterance. The source uses gender essentialism and evolutionary ranking. Its local continuity claim reaches into early Atlantis while the fourth subgroup is in preparation.

events.title: Oracle preservation and the brain as instrument of thought
events.description: The Sun oracle is credited with keeping and passing on etheric patterns of initiates. Among a successor group Steiner describes closer physical–etheric union, diminished older memory and the transformation of the brain into a needed instrument of thought and bodily self-awareness.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 98–99

events.title: Two catastrophe narratives have distinct claimed mechanisms
events.description: The Lemurian transition is connected to I-related use of fire under Luciferic influence. The Atlantean transition is linked to misuse of growth and generation under different conditions, with air and water effects and further migration. Both accounts are Steiner's esoteric prehistory.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 90, 96–99

events.title: Etheric emphasis in the individual-development stream
events.description: GA 185 assigns etheric development to the earliest post-Atlantean individual in its second current, alongside an independent account of the age at which natural maturing ceases. This is a typological emphasis and has no bearing on established human biology.

events.title: The sentient body in the individual-development stream
events.description: GA 185 assigns the sentient body to the second cultural period at the scale of typical individual development. The passage separately assigns the sentient soul to the following period at that same scale.

events.title: Sentient soul in one stream and a later analogy in another
events.description: GA 185 assigns the sentient soul to the Egyptian-Chaldean period in its individual stream. In the separate whole-humanity stream, Steiner also calls fifth-age humanity analogous to the individual age band he associates with that same soul member.

events.title: First Greco-Roman subperiod and inward independence
events.description: GA 181 marks a first subperiod around 747 to 27 BCE. Steiner describes waning felt membership in a spiritual cosmos and connects more self-contained human experience with Greek culture. He presents the subsequent Christ event and secular culture as concurrent currents.

audited_passages.citation: GA 181 · Essential Aspects of Consciousness for the Present and the Future VI · §§ 2–5

events.title: Second Greco-Roman subperiod and dogmatic reception
events.description: In a middle subperiod approximately 27 BCE to 693 CE, Steiner interprets the spread of external Christian doctrine as concurrent with difficulty understanding the Christ event through immediate cognition. This is the lecture's interpretation of church history.

audited_passages.citation: GA 181 · Essential Aspects of Consciousness for the Present and the Future VI · §§ 2, 5–8

events.title: Third Greco-Roman subperiod and the split of faith and knowledge
events.description: For the period approximately 693 to 1413 CE, GA 181 describes a separation between knowing by human concepts and accepting supersensible matters under revelatory authority. The boundary dates are approximate and the characterization concerns Steiner's European narrative.

audited_passages.citation: GA 181 · Essential Aspects of Consciousness for the Present and the Future VI · §§ 2, 8–10

events.title: Golgotha as a second current within the cultural sequence
events.description: GA 201 describes a continuous succession of cultures and a second current entering it at Golgotha, with its own proposed time symmetry. The historical sequence supplies the setting. Steiner assigns the Christ event a distinct spiritual origin.

events.title: Older and newer initiation overlap
events.description: GA 13 describes residual natural supersensible faculties among some initiates during and beyond the fourth period. It also describes a newer way of developing cognition through human understanding and feeling, in which the Christ mysteries become central.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · VI. Present and Future Evolution of the World and of Mankind · §§ 3–5

events.title: Three concurrent scales of soul development
events.description: GA 185 distinguishes humanity-wide maturation, the individual development of the consciousness soul, and a third current attributed to peoples. The first current is likened to the span in which an individual develops the sentient soul. The lecture's national character generalizations are historically situated and unsupported as descriptions of present peoples.

events.title: Conscious social insight in the consciousness-soul age
events.description: Steiner asks listeners to notice the human labor behind an everyday purchase and to revisit their own past from a more objective standpoint. He presents these exercises as ways to counter isolation and deliberately cultivate interest in other people.

events.title: Earth epochs nested inside the physical form condition
events.description: GA 104 places the seven great Earth epochs inside the fourth form stage of Earth's fourth condition of life, numbered 172 in this lecture. The seven post-Atlantean cultures belong to the fifth of those Earth epochs. The local 3–4–4 tally refers to completed subdivisions at three depths.

events.title: The first five seals and transformed cultural fruits
events.description: GA 104a uses horse-and-rider pictures for the first four postwar periods, relating them to the first four cultures. The fifth period is pictured through the white robe and an astral body illuminated by the I. The source marks a gap at the end of the discussion of the fifth seal.

events.title: Philadelphia and the sixth seal occupy different scales
events.description: The lecture moves between a prewar cultural period associated with Philadelphia, its projected interventions in air and light, and an image of their fruits at the sixth seal. The claim that electrical waves and moral actions will cause earthquakes is unsupported.

events.title: Larynx, breath and the post-trumpet astral image
events.description: Steiner takes the larynx and incoming breath as an example in his apocalyptic interpretation of bodily organs leaving astral forms. The claim belongs to his spiritual forecast and supplies no evidence for anatomical development or physiological function.

events.title: Post-catastrophe choice, altered conditions and distant lunar work
events.description: GA 13 projects seven periods after the convulsion and treats prior choices as preparation for altered spiritual conditions. It then describes lunar return and transformative assistance farther ahead, without supplying the seal-by-seal concordance or dating lunar return to a specific seal.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · VI. Present and Future Evolution of the World and of Mankind · §§ 7–8

events.title: Period arithmetic and the precision of calendar labels
events.description: GA 184 calculates 2,160 years from its two stated epoch boundaries and obtains a midpoint by halving the interval. This supports the period length as Steiner's arithmetic convention. Dates obtained by projecting the interval onto other cultures are editorial derivatives, with a calendar-year-zero ambiguity around the BCE/CE crossover.

audited_passages.citation: GA 184 · Lecture Four · 747 BCE / 1413 and 2,160-year calculation

events.title: Early soul-member differentiation and the I
events.description: GA 13 distinguishes an early Earth differentiation of sentient, intellectual and consciousness soul in the astral constitution from the culmination that allows the Spirits of Form to kindle the I. Its German §77 names Bewusstseinsseele where the Adams translation uses spiritual soul.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 71, 77

events.title: The sevenfold pattern loosens and intersecting cycles remain in use
events.description: In the 1924 priests' lecture Steiner says numerical regularity begins to shift with the consciousness-soul age. He still uses a seven-part archangelic cycle intersecting the longer cultural periods. The archive's §12 is printed in German in this English source view.

events.title: Michael and the Christ event from two vantage points
events.description: Steiner juxtaposes arrival of Christ on Earth with the farewell experienced by Michael's hosts on the Sun. Michael's later age signifies following Christ's descent, with a future role preceding Christ's deeds on Earth.

events.title: Ephesus also symbolizes the Oriphiel interval
events.description: Steiner can use the same church imagery for intersecting archangelic ages. Ephesus is associated here with the first smaller cycle, contemporary with the beginnings of Christianity. This supplies a second association alongside GA 104 III's first cultural period.

events.title: The fifth-phase migration and bodily self-awareness
events.description: This lecture begins an eastward migration in the fifth Atlantean phase, calls the formation of a successor group a last-third process, and connects physical–etheric change with capacity for first-person self-awareness. It also contains unsupported claims about ancestry and present-day populations.

events.title: I-work on the astral body begins in dim consciousness
events.description: GA 104 begins partially unconscious activity of the I on the astral body in Lemuria and early Atlantis, yielding what this translation calls the sensory soul. Later application of the I to other members is treated in the same lecture as a sequence.

events.title: Etheric and physical work extend over later Atlantean phases
events.description: The lecture places dim I-work on the etheric body during Atlantis, giving rise to the intellectual soul, and work on the physical body from the last third, giving rise to the consciousness soul. It associates the fuller individual impulse with Christ and distinguishes it from preliminary self-awareness.

events.title: Completion of conscious astral transformation and the last trumpet
events.description: Steiner distinguishes present beginnings of Manas from advanced spiritual self-development at the end of physical Earth. He connects survival into the astralized Earth with transformed etheric organization and interprets Pauline imagery in that context.

events.title: Angels mediate individual and collective work
events.description: GA 121 distinguishes individual work across incarnations from collective impulses. It describes Angels mediating between individual people and Archangels, with Spirits of Personality introducing a further influence at the scale of an age. The lecture's national character and ancestry claims are unsupported.

events.title: Early Earth bodily currents and preparatory organ forms
events.description: Steiner describes etheric humans condensing into mineral-bearing bodies and claims Earth's prior currents continue inward as blood vessels and nerves. He treats the modern umbilical cord as an analogue of a former bond with Earth and names preparatory forms of heart and brain. These are esoteric analogies and developmental claims.

events.title: Atlantean heart rudiment in the lion group-soul account
events.description: GA 104 connects a heart rudiment that later becomes the physical heart with the lion group-soul image. The lecture calls the condensed physical expression of an etheric pattern a horn. The source supplies an Atlantean bodily threshold in its own framework.

events.title: Old Saturn heart germ in the Leo-region account
events.description: GA 110 associates the initial heart germ with the arrest of motion in Old Saturn warmth and the Leo direction, naming activity of Thrones, Seraphim and Cherubim. The breastplate and Cancer discussion is adjacent and refers to a different structure.

events.title: The I enters the intellectual soul around 333 in a 1924 account
events.description: Steiner places an entry of the I into the intellectual soul around 333 CE, and reads the Arius–Athanasius controversy as an external expression. The lecture also phrases an interval as 333 years after Golgotha, leaving its calendar convention to be compared across editions. His reading is a spiritual interpretation of church history.

events.title: Inherited conditions and the Christ impulse within individual life
events.description: Steiner distinguishes inherited father-line impulses from a Christ or Son impulse that he says can be received through the soul within a person's earthly life. The latter belongs to the individual's development and operates at a different scale from a cultural period.

events.title: Human spiritual fruits prepare Future Jupiter
events.description: GA 104 compares Earth's previous preparation of bodily forms with the future formative influence of what people accomplish through soul and etheric transformation. This concerns preparation during spiritualized Earth for its future planetary condition.

events.title: The fifth Atlantean phase and first I-soul impulse
events.description: GA 104 distinguishes the first four phases in its group-soul account from the fifth, where it locates a first impulse toward individualized I-soul. It later reuses their animal-head imagery in its apocalyptic treatment, with an altered meaning.

events.title: From the white robes to the seventh seal
events.description: Steiner recaps the fifth and sixth postwar periods, then describes the seventh seal through divergent conditions: one group can act from an invisible sphere while another remains bound to matter. He introduces the Angels' earlier developmental path as an analogy for the first group's future capacities.

events.title: Atlantis recapitulated as consciously regained clairvoyance
events.description: In this lecture the seals era as a whole recapitulates Atlantis through consciously acquired clairvoyance. GA 104a II-9 additionally links individual seals with fruits of earlier post-Atlantean cultures. These correspondences have different chronological scales.

events.title: Trumpet images and continuing physical conditions
events.description: Steiner places the trumpets at a Devachanic level of hearing while describing a remaining Earth below. He explicitly numbers the first three images and the sixth. The darkening and first woe material sits between them in the prose and requires careful comparison before assigning every image a number.

events.title: Individuality, spiritual fire and recurrence of Lemuria
events.description: Steiner links receiving the Christ impulse with accepting distinct individualities and emerging from conditions of group soul. He compares the trumpet era with a spiritually transformed Lemuria, connecting its fire imagery with a higher rather than material condition.

events.title: Two directions of reunion at the seventh trumpet
events.description: The lecture projects a division in which the subtle portion of Earth reunites with the Sun while the dense portion combines with the Moon. Steiner calls it a transformed echo of the earlier solar separation. The resulting sequence requires comparison with GA 13's differently phrased reunion account.

events.title: Christ as planetary spirit and Sorat as a named adversary
events.description: Steiner links Zarathustra's earlier teaching, Golgotha and Christ's projected role in reunion with the Sun. He calls Sorat a solar adversary affecting the astral body and presents 666 as a name-number correspondence in his reading of Revelation.

events.title: GA 346 uses two expressions for the 333 placement
events.description: The published German text gives year 333 after Christ in §3 and 333 years after the Mystery of Golgotha in §14. It again identifies the year 333 in §§22 and 34. The two anchors occur in the German as well as the English and need to be recorded separately when reconstructing the lecture's schematic interval.

events.title: The year 666 in the 1924 historical reading
events.description: Steiner uses 666 as a historical year in his account of tensions in Christianity after 333. The lecture attributes spiritual opposition to Islam and an undifferentiated notion of Arab culture. These are sectarian esoteric claims and unsuitable as history or as descriptions of Muslims.

events.title: Karmic continuity and sacramental transformation
events.description: Steiner links the 333 placement to individual freedom and a loss of insight into connections between lives. He ascribes a common non-hereditary activity to the shaping of destiny across lives and to transubstantiation. His scenario in which Julian succeeds is explicitly a hypothesis.

events.title: Sorat, the second 666 interval and the Templar episode
events.description: The lecture gives 1332 as the second 666-year marker and interprets the earlier destruction of the Templars and death of Jacques de Molay in that thematic setting. The year 1332 is an arithmetic marker in Steiner's interpretation. The lecture supplies separate earlier dates for the institutional and biographical events.

events.title: Michael's successive roles and the supersensible school
events.description: Steiner places Michael with Aristotle and Alexander before Golgotha, then describes a supersensible school spanning the fourteenth through sixteenth centuries and preparing individuals for his modern Michael age. The dates concern his account of spiritual activity.

events.title: The 1998 marker and distinct twentieth-century forecasts
events.description: In 1924 Steiner projected an etheric manifestation of Christ in the first half of the twentieth century and activity of Sorat later in the century, naming 1998 as the third 666 marker. His wording also describes a rising threat before that marker. Treat these as recorded forecasts, with no judgment about people from physical features or politics.

events.title: The Apocalypse as collective Christian initiation
events.description: Steiner describes an initial period of transmission from witnesses, followed by a role for Revelation in Christian development. In his account the Apocalypse can work into the etheric body and initiate a collective process in which individuals may participate. He gives examples of this reception from the second through sixth centuries.

events.title: Destruction of Jerusalem and the seed of a future formation
events.description: The lecture places destruction of old Jerusalem after Golgotha and explicitly says the destruction could have taken place without that event. Steiner connects Golgotha with preparing a different future formation, the New Jerusalem, which he describes as developing from that point.

events.title: Future city as a continuation of bodily formation
events.description: Steiner presents the New Jerusalem as a future extension of the human being through spiritual knowledge and art. His explanation also assigns bodily nourishment to a speculative threefold system that conflicts with established physiology. The vision of a future city has no exact calendar placement here.

events.title: Blood-marked garment and three modes of Christ activity
events.description: Steiner reads Revelation 19 as portraying Christ inwardly, through the garment associated with Golgotha and the Logos, and through deeds in humanity. He explicitly describes the developing condition as lacking a specific year. Blood in this passage is scriptural symbolism.

events.title: Three projected falls differ by their sphere of activity
events.description: The sequence assigns the fall of Babylon to certain bodily conditions, the Beast and false prophet to direct Ahrimanic activity, and Satan to a claimed disruption of planetary order. The lecture gives a relative order for these outcomes. Its rhetoric about individuals and its astronomical claims are historically attributed esoteric material.

events.title: Christ as balance in the reading of Revelation 19
events.description: Steiner places Babylon on the Ahrimanic side, interprets the rejoicing above at its fall as Luciferic, and associates Christ with balance between the two. This passage links both influences with one apocalyptic scene.

events.title: Three early Earth recapitulations and the novelty of Atlantis
events.description: Steiner explicitly associates Earth's first three periods with higher-level repetitions of Old Saturn, Old Sun and Old Moon. He calls the fourth, Atlantean period new in that particular sequence. The source places this relation at the great Earth-epoch level.

events.title: Greco-Roman culture repeats Atlantis at the soul level
events.description: The lecture compares Atlantean accounts of perceiving spirit in solid-liquid conditions with Greco-Roman perception in liquid-airy conditions. It relates the 333 and 666 markers to earlier, unspecified Atlantean upheavals by analogy. This is a different recapitulation from the postwar seals account.

events.title: Anticipated conscious images in the Michael age
events.description: Steiner invokes inner warmth and the etheric Christ to project conscious visionary images of earlier Earth conditions. He distinguishes these images from an Atlantean physical experience and a Greco-Roman soul experience. The account is a forecast made in 1924.

events.title: Mid-Atlantean solar birth and stages of I-awareness
events.description: Steiner associates the solar birth image with a gradual awakening of I-awareness in Atlantis. He distinguishes continued activation from outside through the Sun from later inward residence of the I in the fourth post-Atlantean age. This supplies a development spanning two great Earth epochs.

events.title: Michael and dragon imagery across Atlantis and later periods
events.description: Steiner connects a struggle of Michael in the Sun with mid-Atlantean changes, then compares the image with later mythological forms and a projected renewed vision in the Michael age. His account also connects the seven-headed beast with the Atlantean transition. These references are multiple uses of images across times.

events.title: The seven Earth life conditions and their distinct kingdoms
events.description: The lecture names three elemental conditions followed by mineral, plant, animal, and human life conditions. It distinguishes humanity's esoteric mineral condition from ordinary biological classification, and warns against applying these Earth names to the analogous Saturn and Sun conditions.

events.title: Physical form is the middle of seven forms within a life condition
events.description: The form sequence descends through higher Devachan, lower Devachan and astral to physical. It then ascends through transformed astral, lower and higher Devachan. The mineral life condition extends through those forms. The German clarifies that three completed states in §25 are life conditions, each with seven forms.

events.title: Representative life on Old Saturn
events.description: Steiner answers how Old Saturn could include life conditions before the human etheric body. He attributes the representative life to the activity of higher beings who permeate the human rudiment with their own members, while the human germ lacks independent life.

events.title: Planetary intervals and successive forms
events.description: Steiner describes spiritual intervals between planetary embodiments. The globes in this diagram are successive forms of an evolving sphere. He describes astral Earth in connection with the bowls of wrath and qualifies the diagram as conceptual scaffolding.

events.title: Five levels in the numerical schematic
events.description: GA 104 adds two depths beneath the form level: great epoch and smaller period. It explicitly illustrates this with physical Earth, the seals and trumpets, and the seven post-Atlantean cultural periods. The numerical total 16,807 describes the idealized full five-depth scheme, with far fewer intervals individually described in this lecture.

events.title: Four early heads, three later heads and ten horns
events.description: Steiner connects the first four Atlantean phases to group-soul images and the crossing into the fifth to emerging individuality. His account locates conscious perception of sexual difference at an Atlantean threshold and uses the head-and-horn imagery again for projected astral Earth.

events.title: Post-trumpet branches and Mammon in the lower astral world
events.description: Steiner distinguishes higher astral and eventual Devachanic development from a lower astral branch. He names Mammon as a spirit of obstacles and places reunion with the Sun after the trumpet period for those capable of it.

events.title: Luciferic benefits, costs and later redemption
events.description: Steiner associates the Lemurian intervention with deeper material involvement and the possibility of human independence. The beings act through the astral body and experience aspects of development there that they missed earlier. He projects later human participation in their redemption.

events.title: Opposing figures and a renewed act of assistance
events.description: Steiner distinguishes left-behind Luciferic spirits, humans whom he treats as having remained behind without conscious choice, and those he depicts as deliberately turning spiritual powers toward selfish aims. He projects a return of spiritually developed humans from union with the Sun to assist the second group.

events.title: Jupiter-Earth, Venus-Earth and Vulcan-Earth are anticipations within Earth
events.description: In this lecture Steiner says Earth's rounds look back to Saturn, Sun and Moon and anticipate later planetary conditions. He places renewed opportunities for assistance on Jupiter-Earth, a last opportunity on Venus-Earth, and its closing by Vulcan-Earth. The German explicitly says the anticipations occur within the actual Earth condition.

events.title: Art, Babylon and the future New Jerusalem
events.description: The text places the casting away of evil in a Venus-Earth setting and calls this the Fall of Babylon. It also treats present human artistic work as formative for a future New Jerusalem and mentions a Jupiter existence. The boundaries of that final reference remain open.

events.title: Etheric head enters and gradually supports I-development
events.description: The lecture ties late Atlantean preparation to a changing relation of etheric and physical head and distinguishes that development from Golgotha's more significant impulse. German Hereinrücken indicates an inward movement where SOL English says emergence. The source's analogy involving hydrocephalus has no standing as modern medicine.

events.title: Preparatory transformation and the higher members
events.description: Steiner describes transformation of astral, etheric and physical bodies into Spirit Self, Life Spirit and Spirit Man. He distinguishes preparatory work through higher beings and initially unconscious work from subsequent conscious activity. The same passage links earlier transformations with the three soul members.

events.title: Six cultural emphases and preparation for Philadelphia
events.description: The sequence gives etheric body, astral body, sentient soul, intellectual soul, consciousness soul and Spirit Self as successive organizations permeated by the I. The Philadelphia passage associates Spirit Self and etheric Christ recognition. It does not name a seventh member in this sequence.

events.title: How Philadelphia prepares the sixth-seal community
events.description: Steiner connects the fourth to sixth seal periods with development of the three soul forces and preparation for Manas. He derives the 144,000 symbol through numerical interpretation and links a community prepared during Philadelphia with the sixth seal.

events.title: Babylon, the Venus-Earth count and the eighth sphere
events.description: Steiner juxtaposes the sixth seal and a sixth condition at a different scale. He attributes a separation to an eighth sphere to the Venus-Earth setting and invokes the two witnesses in a future act of assistance.
