The work uses a different predicate for Babylon here than the previous lecture, and gives no modern absolute date.

events.title: Future heart and speech-organ transformations
events.description: Steiner connects future human development with a changed heart function and a projected reproductive capacity of speech. He notes an anatomical feature of heart muscle before making a separate esoteric forecast. The forecast carries no empirical or medical authority.

events.title: Universal cooperation and the occult image of homelessness
events.description: Steiner uses homelessness as a technical term for gaining perspective on attachments to locality or heritage. He envisages a later common human task in which contributions can be made freely. This terminology refers to his initiatory concept.

events.title: Preparatory soul activity and later threefold transformation
events.description: GA 121 describes present beginnings of Spirit Self, distinguishes the three preparatory soul members, and links the future work of the I on the astral, etheric and physical bodies to Spirit Self, Life Spirit and Spirit Man respectively.

events.title: Archangelic activity and succession of Spirits of the Age
events.description: Steiner distinguishes Angels' human stage on Old Moon from present physical humanity. He attributes transformation toward Life Spirit to Archangels and associates Spirits of Personality with changing eras. In his account they hand over offices and return after other spirits have held them.

events.title: Population movements in an etheric account of regions
events.description: Steiner treats regional etheric auras as changing with migration, giving the European Migration Period as an example. He distinguishes the activity he attributes to Archangels from physical terrain and assigns a different temporal pattern to an individual etheric aura. The account's national temperament typology is historically situated and unsupported.

events.title: The speech apparatus and two groups at an archangelic level
events.description: Steiner attributes national temperament to normally developed Archangels and the shaping of the larynx and speech apparatus to cooperation involving Spirits of Form who retained an archangelic mode of activity. He associates another action of Spirits of Form with shaping the brain for saying I. These are attributed esoteric claims about human organs.

events.title: Outer historical conditions and inward shaping of thought
events.description: GA 121 distinguishes normally developed Spirits of Personality associated with historical circumstances from Spirits of Form retained at another developmental level and associated with shaping thought from within. The lecture presents both influences as potentially concurrent.

events.title: Three modifications of the astral body and degrees of I-awareness
events.description: The lecture treats the three soul members as modifications within the human astral body and relates them to dim, emerging, and clear I-awareness. It associates analogous modifications of Archangels with their etheric bodies. This is a description of organization and experience.

events.title: Mediation, differential roles, and retained modes of activity
events.description: Steiner gives Angels a mediating role and distinguishes coordination across several hierarchies from their members' own developmental work. The discussion also assigns racial categories to spiritual influences in a historically situated typology. Its claims about ancestry or national character are unsupported.

events.title: Astral germ and the first etheric organization
events.description: GA 11 depicts an astral germ carrying forces from earlier conditions. Astral humans chiefly work from outside on their etheric counterparts, forming organs and awakening etheric life. The chapter names this opening condition Polarean.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · IX. Beginning of the Present Earth—Extrusion of the Sun · §§ 1–2

events.title: Air-like matter, chemical ether, water and light ether
events.description: In GA 11 an air-like condensation leaves the chemical ether alongside the earlier life ether. The air-like condition subsequently differentiates into air-like and watery conditions, and light ether differentiates from chemical ether. Descendants of earlier forms continue alongside newer human-like, animal-like and plant-like organizations.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · IX. Beginning of the Present Earth—Extrusion of the Sun · §§ 3–6

events.title: Watery conditions already appear before solar separation in GA 11
events.description: The essay names water, air and three ethers before narrating the Sun's separation. Greater densification and an internal source of heat follow. GA 13 IV §66 places solar separation before watery incorporation in the narrated sequence, so the two accounts retain separate stage orderings.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · IX. Beginning of the Present Earth—Extrusion of the Sun · §§ 5–8

events.title: Fire-mist enables concurrent embodiment and distinct activity
events.description: GA 11 gives human beings a dim conscious life and externally directed activity within the fire mist. It gives higher beings a shared medium in which their decisions can organize denser conditions. The source describes upward development of human understanding and downward extension of higher beings' activity at the same time.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · X. Extrusion of the Moon · §§ 1–3

events.title: Reproduction and understanding follow two different agencies
events.description: The chapter transfers lunar influence to external regulation of reproduction after the Moon's separation, while describing renewed Luciferic activity in awakening human understanding. It identifies the preceding fire-mist period as an interruption in that Luciferic activity and leaves more precise identifications for later chapters.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · X. Extrusion of the Moon · §§ 4–8

events.title: Inherited organization and solar separation in GA 13
events.description: GA 13 distinguishes recapitulation of the three earlier bodies, a spiritual interval, and a new astral descent with physical laws already present. In its material sequence the Sun separates from the fire-air Earth before Earth incorporates water. Sun beings then influence Earth from outside and the text relates this to alternating consciousness.

audited_passages.citation: GA 13 · IV. Man and the Evolution of the World · §§ 61–67

events.title: The trumpets on a consciousness-soul timescale
events.description: In 1924 Steiner explicitly distinguishes the trumpets as an interpretation of consciousness-soul development from the longer development of the astral body and humanity that he had emphasized in 1908. He calls the processes interwoven and places his present within the trumpets only on the narrower scale.

events.title: The sixth trumpet and an edition-dependent decade
events.description: German §6 refers to the beginning of the forties immediately after §5 discusses 1843–44. The SOL English inserts 1940s. Section 23 describes the sixth trumpet as already underway for the 1924 audience. The narrower chronology concerns Steiner's interpretation of consciousness-soul development.

events.title: Golgotha to the Crusades as a smaller seals epoch
events.description: In Steiner's smaller historical interpretation, the period from Golgotha to the Crusades belongs to the opening of the seals and the Crusades mark a transition to the trumpets. He interprets changing Christian institutions and mystical inwardness through these images. The lecture's sectarian judgments belong to its esoteric interpretation.

events.title: The 1413 boundary and the antecedents of the trumpet motifs
events.description: The lecture dates the beginning of the consciousness-soul age to 1413 on Earth while tracing the associated trumpet motifs back to the Crusades. It places a projected seventh trumpet near the end of the twentieth century on this same narrower scale. Its language about the absence of an I cannot be used to classify people.

events.title: An individual threshold and a historical threshold for humanity
events.description: Steiner presents the individual crossing of the threshold as a differentiation of spirit, soul, and body, and claims humanity as a whole undergoes a related process in the consciousness-soul age. He reads the cloud-borne face, rainbow, and fiery feet of Revelation 10 as images of thought, feeling, and bodily life.

events.title: The 2,160-year period and Steiner’s proposed textual change
events.description: Steiner gives an approximate cultural span as one twelfth of 25,920 years and proposes reading 2,160 days in two passages of Revelation transmitted as 1,260. The German confirms the proposal. The source supplies Steiner's conjectural reading, with no independently verified textual emendation established here.

events.title: The sea of glass as a projected Earth change
events.description: Steiner interprets the sea of glass as a future reflective watery condition associated with a reduction of the present seasonal extremes. He attributes a role to collective human inner activity. This is a prediction in the lecture's esoteric cosmology.

events.title: Divine love, light, and the future bowls
events.description: The lecture associates divine equilibrium with love manifesting outwardly as light. It interprets the bowls in a future age as an altered expression of that love after it meets materialistic human conditions. The lecture describes destructive results as removing obstacles to further development.

events.title: Atlantean catastrophe and a future moral–natural correspondence
events.description: Steiner uses the Atlantean catastrophe as an earlier instance of what he regards as human conduct altering natural phenomena. He forecasts a related process in the future and connects it with the bowls. Both the retrospective cause and the physical forecast are claims of his esoteric interpretation.

events.title: Comet imagery in the 1924 Apocalypse interpretation
events.description: Steiner connects the beast motifs with comet forms and describes Biela's comet and the 1872 meteor shower in relation to supposed activity in the astral body. He also associates the imagery with Michael's approach in the late 1870s. The astronomical and therapeutic statements are attributed esoteric claims.

events.title: The beast in 1933 and understanding the etheric Christ
events.description: The 1924 lecture gives a qualified 1933 catastrophe scenario in its comet interpretation and associates 1933 with the beast motif before fuller understanding of the etheric Christ. The scope differs from the 1998 Sorat marker in lecture VIII. The passage records a forecast and spiritual interpretation.

events.title: Initiation sequence through seals, trumpets, and hierarchies
events.description: Steiner treats seals and trumpets as stages of perception in an initiatory reading, with elemental effects giving way to an encounter with the second hierarchy and its harmony. He associates the next spiritual region with angels, archangels and Archai. This is a sequence of perception in addition to historical or planetary readings.

events.title: Breakdown, glandular imagery and bowls as macrocosmic analogy
events.description: The lecture associates bodily breakdown with spiritual activity and compares excretion to the vessels of wrath. It explicitly uses the word gland in a microcosm–macrocosm correspondence. Its claims about brain processes and the body are esoteric, and the image does not establish a physiological mechanism.

events.title: Three scales of activity in the third hierarchy
events.description: Steiner assigns care of an individual's soul to angels, guidance of groups to archangels, and movement of events from age to age to Archai. He depicts these beings together as the expression of higher hierarchies.

events.title: Intellectuality in the consciousness-soul age and later development
events.description: Steiner describes intellectuality entering individual human activity in the current age, then reaching deeper emotional and passionate life. He associates a later Jupiter stage with its extension into human physicality. The lecture leaves the future placement at the named stage level.

events.title: Independent intellect as a point of vulnerability in GA 346
events.description: Steiner identifies an Ahrimanic power called Satan in this passage, assigns it rank among the Archai, and links its activity to the independence of human intellect. He distinguishes present human susceptibility from exceptional or future possibilities involving angelic beings. The proposed human response depends on voluntary spiritual alignment.

events.title: Gog and Magog as a conditional group-level sequence
events.description: Steiner interprets Gog and Magog as groups exposed to a projected temptation operating through intellect. He gives Michael and freely directed human spiritual activity a role in the outcome. The lecture presents an alternative adverse future contingent on human action without assigning a calendar date.

events.title: Sacramental reading of the three hierarchies
events.description: The closing lecture interprets transubstantiation as an encounter with the hidden work of the first hierarchy in physical substance, with Christ leading toward a second-hierarchy disclosure and a region associated with the third hierarchy and the Holy Spirit. This is a sacramental account of spiritual perception.

events.title: Old Saturn and variable trance-like awareness
events.description: Steiner assigns the rudimentary human organization a predominant awareness duller than dreamless sleep. He explicitly allows variation within Saturn and says other beings then possessed what he calls human consciousness.

events.title: Old Sun and the dreamless-sleep analogue
events.description: Steiner compares the predominant Old Sun awareness to present dreamless sleep and to the condition he attributes to plants. These are analogies within his account of consciousness.

events.title: Old Moon image awareness and its Atlantean reprise
events.description: Steiner describes vivid images corresponding to the spiritual environment, distinguishes them from fragmented present dreams, and says this condition was repeated during Atlantean evolution as Earth developed waking object consciousness.

events.title: Jupiter preserves waking awareness in conscious imaging
events.description: In Steiner’s projection, Jupiter consciousness combines image perception with the clear awareness proper to Earth. He describes initiation as anticipating this combination.

events.title: Venus and inspired tonal consciousness
events.description: Steiner projects an inspired awareness in which an inner character appears as a unified tone and beings formerly experienced as images are perceived as tonal structures.

events.title: Vulcan and intuitive consciousness with individuality
events.description: Steiner calls the projected Vulcan state intuition in a technical sense. The soul participates inwardly in beings within its field of perception and retains its individuality.

events.title: Plant forces, laboratory creation and future ethics
events.description: Steiner projects that understanding plant growth forces will allow the creation of plant forms without seeds. He frames legitimate use as requiring a transformed moral life and links the projected kingdom to shared well-being. These are esoteric forecasts.

events.title: The three completed counts in Steiner’s 344
events.description: Steiner counts three completed forms of the fourth life condition, four completed great epochs of the physical form and four completed post-Atlantean cultural periods. He reads the three digits individually.

events.title: 66, 466 and 666 in the longer trumpet account
events.description: Steiner puts 66 after six trumpets and treats the seventh-trumpet disposition, associated with 466, as still reversible for a time. He reserves final separation for a later 666. The lecture’s adjacent descriptions use different scale terminology for that last formula.

events.title: Conditional prophecy and free choice
events.description: In the authored essay, Steiner distinguishes the purported lawfulness of a result from the free choices that may establish its conditions. He presents spiritual foresight as compatible with freely brought-about events and claims it can guide ideals.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · XI. Some Necessary Points of View · §§ 4–7

events.title: Seven embodiments and living intervals of rest
events.description: Steiner presents humanity and its sphere as co-developing through three past, Earth and three future embodiments. In the intervening pralayas life persists, though conditions elude the senses developed in the open cycles.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · XII. On the Origin of the Earth · §§ 1–5

events.title: Saturn awareness is dim in clarity and broad in reach
events.description: Steiner distinguishes the breadth of awareness from its clarity. He describes Saturn as broader and dimmer than Earth, and distinguishes a trance comparison from a clairvoyant’s claimed retention of waking clarity.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · XII. On the Origin of the Earth · §§ 6–9

events.title: Recapitulated awareness changes form on Sun and Moon
events.description: Steiner has Sun develop the Saturn predisposition again in changed form before its own awareness. Moon subsequently repeats the Saturn and Sun stages in smaller cycles before attaining an image awareness keyed to its surroundings.

audited_passages.citation: GA 11 · XII. On the Origin of the Earth · §§ 9–10

events.title: Older mystery rites and withdrawal of direct divine presence
events.description: Steiner describes a claimed ancient mode of direct contact between gods and officiants, tied to celestial timing. In his semi-ancient mode the gods send powers and the officiants use preserved substances as a means of ritual knowledge. The passage gives a relative order.

events.title: Four levels of ritual reception and the conscious I
events.description: Steiner connects the first three mystery modes to physical, etheric and astral experience. He situates the first Communion within the third mode and describes the modern task as consciously uniting the I with Christ and grasping the rite and revelation.

events.title: Saturn warmth boundary and the experience of wonder
events.description: Steiner depicts early warmth differentiation as a warmer interior and a cooler warmth envelope. He calls its inward experience wonder and uses Alpha and Beta to represent warmth-human and first enclosure.

events.title: Vulcan completion and Christ at Earth’s midpoint
events.description: Steiner interprets Alpha and Omega as the initial human being united with its whole world at Vulcan. He describes Christ at Golgotha as already at the stage humanity would reach at that endpoint.

events.title: Twenty-four Elders and the four living figures
events.description: Steiner interprets the Elders as enduring revelations of successive representatives, including some still to come, assembled around Christ. The four living figures signify humanity as a whole in this scene. The passage supplies no dated sequence of twenty-four eras.

events.title: Loss of remembered pre-existence and persistence of fourth-period habits
events.description: Steiner attributes awareness of pre-earthly life to the first three cultural periods and a growing sense of earthly boundedness to the fourth. He says fourth-period habits persist into the fifth through education and public life.

events.title: Consciousness soul and an awareness of continuous dying
events.description: Steiner predicts that people will increasingly experience dying as active throughout life. His fire image concerns the felt transition into wakefulness and the inward cost of awareness. The reference belongs to his phenomenology of consciousness.

events.title: Sixth cultural period and changed perception of nature
events.description: Steiner distinguishes the fifth period’s change in self-perception from a sixth-period change in how the surroundings are experienced. He interprets falling stars in terms of awareness of spiritual activity behind the visible heavens.

events.title: Sardis as the fifth church and fifth seal in the smaller reading
events.description: Steiner applies the Sardis image and the fifth seal to the modern fifth cultural period and urges his priestly audience to realize the task in daily life. GA 346 XIII separately explains the smaller scale used in this course.

events.title: The free I as a capacity for love and hardening
events.description: The lecture traces the I to differentiation from group-soul consciousness. Steiner interprets the two-edged sword as the capacity to deepen free individuality or harden it into selfish conflict. He assigns the War of All Against All to the second trajectory.

events.title: The sixth cultural period prepares a later community
events.description: Steiner associates Philadelphia with spiritual brotherhood and treats souls formed in the sixth cultural period as a foundation of post-war cultures. He describes the transition through an analogy with his account of the end of Atlantis.

events.title: A reversible separation and the future educational task
events.description: Steiner assigns a future effort to draw back separated people to those he calls disciples of Manichaeism. He still allows recovery at the astral transition. The passage records his reconstruction of Manichaeism and its projected role.

events.title: Late Lemurian to Atlantean migration in the 1908 account
events.description: Steiner distinguishes early ethereal Earth conditions from the later epochs and attributes the founding of Atlantean populations to an emigrating minority of the last Lemurian group. This is an esoteric prehistory with racialized terminology.

events.title: Christ-derived love and the astralization of Earth
events.description: Steiner associates the physical-to-astral transition with the capacity to dissolve material form through love. He interprets seven bowls of wrath through the expulsion of hardened matter. The account places this transition before its final irreversible outcome.

events.title: Transformation of the three bodies through the I
events.description: Steiner calls the I’s transformation of the astral body Spirit Self, of the etheric body Life Spirit and of the physical body Spirit Man. Earth permits development of these members, while their full development belongs to a more distant future.

events.title: The separated Earth and the horns as hardened limbs
events.description: After the trumpets Steiner describes an astral Earth and a separate portion unable to participate in its transformation. His reading of the beast’s horns treats them as hardened physical limbs of that portion’s inhabitants.

events.title: Spirits of Form, retarded Spirits of Movement and early awareness
events.description: Steiner credits the Spirits of Form with bestowing the capacity for I-consciousness. He assigns earlier perception of the physical environment in individual development to Spirits of Movement that act at the rank of Form. Ages and stages belong to the lecture’s esoteric account.

events.title: Lemurian bodily differentiation and a cultural-repetition thesis
events.description: Steiner associates Lemurian bodily differentiation with locality and reproduction under beings he calls abnormal Spirits of Form. He then describes post-Atlantean cultural stages as changed repetitions of previous bodily conditions. The racial and geographic claims are historically situated and unsupported.

events.title: Early physical growth as a recurrence of Saturn
events.description: Steiner connects the physical organization from birth to the change of teeth with an individual reprise of Old Saturn. He distinguishes that model of repeated physical development from the distinctive Earth work of the Spirits of Form on the I.

stage_notes.earth-polar: GA 11 VIII changes the reference point from preterrestrial astral life to etheric embodiment. Its hearing analogy describes a whole-body function.
stage_notes.earth-hyper: GA 11 VIII groups the first two epochs in one retrospective account. Its gradual cosmic separation in §10 should be read alongside the more detailed order in IX–X.
stage_notes.earth-lemur: GA 11 supplies descriptions of pre-division anatomy, local group development and a volcanic transition. GA 13 relates form, I, lunar withdrawal and agency without supplying a calendar.
stage_notes.earth-atlant: Read the seven overlapping phases in GA 11 III alongside the broad account of altered life-body, oracle and sensory experience in GA 13 IV. The sources provide no exact alignment for every process.
stage_notes.earth-post: The seven cultural periods are nested within this Earth epoch. Dates describe Steiner’s typology and some are inferred using his period arithmetic. GA 13 allows cultural continuities across the boundaries.
stage_notes.earth-sixth: GA 104 places the seven seals here after the War of All Against All. GA 104a treats early seals as astral images of transformed cultural fruits and sometimes moves back to the prewar cultures while discussing them.
stage_notes.earth-seventh: The trumpet subdivisions complete the physical-form sequence in GA 104. The lecture then describes further forms on Earth before a later Earth condition of life. A full trumpet-by-trumpet case remains open.
stage_notes.period-10: Preserved Atlantean perception and its teaching provide a baseline for GA 13’s cultural account. The account explicitly distinguishes the first period from later India.
stage_notes.period-11: Earthly work and the visibility of spiritual activity in the sensory world replace earlier emphases in Steiner’s typology. Ancient Persian spiritual content is projected to recur in transformed form in the sixth period.
stage_notes.period-12: Steiner groups several cultural settings in one typology while describing different initiation streams. The fifth culture is said to revisit earlier spiritual content with awakened individual faculties.
stage_notes.period-13: The mind or intellectual soul is the development foregrounded at the individual scale. GA 181 subdivides the period into three approximate intervals. GA 201 traces the cultural and Christological currents through the same time.
stage_notes.period-14: The age grows out of earlier processes and is marked by an emphasis on consciously cultivated cognition and action. GA 185 assigns the consciousness soul and the sentient-soul analogy to different currents.
stage_notes.period-15: A projected consolidation of capacities prepared in the fifth. GA 106 connects the period with the transformed Persian current. GA 104 identifies Philadelphia with the growth of brotherly love.
stage_notes.period-16: A projected final culture within the fifth great Earth epoch. GA 106 compares it with the first period, while GA 13 emphasizes altered developmental opportunities and a subsequent upheaval.
stage_notes.cos-saturn: The seven cosmic dossiers remain the primary stage studies. This supplement points to a targeted comparison of the Old Saturn and Atlantean heart accounts.
